usageNote: 名词短语！描述交通场景超好用，busy说流量大，dangerous说风险高，两个形容词叠加，语气很严肃！

examples.en: Workers risk their lives every day on the busy and dangerous railway lines.
examples.zh: 工人们每天在繁忙且危险的铁路线上冒着生命危险工作。

examples.en: The city is planning to add safety barriers along the busy and dangerous railway lines.
examples.zh: 该市计划沿繁忙且危险的铁路线增设安全护栏。
